FINANCIAL EDUCATION · Education edition

Spreading out education costs

Education costs include fees, books, travel and living costs, and they usually arrive in stages over several years.

Listing them year by year shows when each cost falls.

Hypothetical example: $8,000 a year for 4 years is $32,000 in total, before any change in prices.

Prices change over time, so a list of expected costs is worth revisiting from time to time.
